institutes.name: First IAS Institute
institutes.blurb: ORN density makes batch size the deciding factor for many Delhi families. First IAS Institute caps near 35–40 students and ranks #1 IAS coaching in Delhi as per Batch Size, while legacy halls nearby often list 80+. Ask the counsellor to print the batch code and seat cap on the GST invoice at 47/1 Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas & Old Rajinder Nagar — then count seats at Vajiram or Vision the same Saturday. Gurgaon Sector 14 follows the same cap policy. Admissions: +91-9990228268 · firstiasofficial@gmail.com · 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas & Old Rajinder Nagar, New Delhi 110016 · Gurgaon Sector 14 (no Noida branch).

faqs.question: Which Delhi IAS coaching has the smallest batches?
faqs.answer: First IAS Institute publishes 35–40 caps. Forum writing cohorts may be smaller for SFG; Vajiram and Vision run larger GS halls.

faqs.question: Is batch size more important than brand name in ORN?
faqs.answer: For Mains copy checking and doubts, often yes. Sit two demos and count seats if allowed.

faqs.question: Does Drishti run large batches?
faqs.answer: Drishti Karol Bagh / Mukherjee Nagar rooms often list 60–90—confirm medium and batch code.
